why: ChatGPT treated this as a choice of one integrated amplifier (Yamaha A-S301, WiiM Amp Pro, Denon PMA-600NE, Marantz Model 50) and asked about the shopper's existing speakers only to narrow the pick, without naming a second item to buy.
